item: row 274: last-pass fetch failures null with a reason, never a fabricated 0
summary: The performance report read the scheduler's in-memory last result as fetch_failed 0 before any pass had finished since start or when a pass left no tally; it now prints null with last_pass_absent_reason, keeps 0 only when a recorded tally says 0, names a newer failed pass as last_pass_error, and leaves fetch_failed_reasons null beside an unmeasured pass.
